title: Hub firmware
intro: Update the hub's own firmware with a .bin file. Metering isn't interrupted: the modules keep counting, the hub credits the gap. If the new firmware doesn't start, the hub goes back to the previous one by itself.
confirmBody: The hub takes the file, restarts (offline for about half a minute) and confirms the new firmware a minute after it starts. Don't power the hub off until it's done.
problem_notImage: This isn't a firmware file (no ESP image header).
problem_noDesc: The file has no firmware description — not a hub application image.
problem_project: This is another device's firmware, not the hub's (hub project: {project}).
problem_chip: Firmware for another chip — doesn't fit this hub.
sameBuild: This build is already installed. No need to update.
stage_restarting: The hub wrote the firmware and is restarting…
stage_confirming: The hub is back. Waiting for the new firmware to confirm (about a minute)…
done: Done: the hub runs the new firmware — version {version}, build {built}.
rolledBack: The new firmware didn't start — the hub went back to the previous one. Details in “Events → Hub log”.
unconfirmed: The hub is back, but its log doesn't show the new firmware confirmed yet. Check “Events → Hub log”.
notBack: the hub didn't come back within 3 minutes
